use_when: An agent or subagent is being granted tools, credentials or MCP access, is about to reach a shared or production system, or acted beyond what the requester could have done.
not_for: The detailed ingestion trust boundary for untrusted content (prompt-injection-defense), scoping what an agent is for (agent-design), building the MCP server itself (mcp-design), and granting any permission the user has not already given.
